note: Sullivan County park on TVA land at South Holston Lake. The B and T sections run along the shore (the booking site's 'Lakeside' category); C and D have lake views. 88 sites are seasonal, assigned by an annual lottery, so nightly sites are the rest. The lake is drawn down about 25 ft in winter. No breaker at the pedestals; a surge protector is advised. --Claude
summary: Observation Knob checked on the park's own site (rates, seasonal, info, about), its campground map, seasonal chart, Staylist portal, Esri and 3DEP: 2026 rates $39 30A (some interior $35), $45 50A (B25/C10/D8/D15); season 04-01..10-31; Staylist booking; showers, two dumps; 88 seasonal sites of ~230; lakefront KEPT on the B section (pads ~1-2.5 m above summer pool, open grass to the shore); pin ~290 m off at the boat ramp.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT (checked hard). The B section (B-1..B-33 nightly on the map; B-25 is a 50A site; B-34/35 seasonal) lies on the lake side of the outer loop road (Willow Ln), and the operator sells B and T as 'Lakeside (B & T Sections)'. 3DEP across the B row at 36.58288,-82.04384: road 529.2 m, grass/riprap edge 526.7 m ~17 m on; South Holston summer pool 1,729 ft = 527.0 m, so the pads are ~1-2.5 m above the summer edge over open grass with scattered trees (passes the kayak test; the winter imagery's orange apron is drawdown). T section (T-6..T-25 nightly, T-1..T-5 primitive) runs along the cove by Cherry Cr; not separately measured. Suggested evidence text: '-> lakefront. B section (B-1..B-33, nightly; operator category Lakeside (B & T Sections)) between Willow Ln and the shore at ~36.5829,-82.0438: road 529.2 m, summer-pool edge (1,729 ft = 527.0 m) ~10-17 m on over open grass (3DEP + Esri 2026-11-25).'

PIN MOVE ~290 m: stored 36.58060,-82.04398 is the boat-ramp/day-use parking lot south of the campground (Esri). The loops' centre is ~36.5830,-82.0452 (3DEP 542.2 m; stored elevation 529.0 -> ~542). The old evidence ('peninsula loops ... at 36.5806,-82.0440') was read at the ramp, but the B row measured above confirms it.
